data.title: Gems Estate
data.about:
Cavalli and jewelry master de Grisogono collaborated on Gems Estates by Damac. Ultra-luxury villas starting at AED 5.82 million are available in five, six, or seven bedrooms. 

There is something enchanting about these massive villas, which have gold features that provide a glimpse into another dimension. The black and gold color scheme and graceful curves of the more prominent features are subtle nods to Klimpt’s artwork. Located near major highways and destinations, this community has excellent amenities.
